approvedScope: One fixed 3-second post-write hold before closing the same standard HTTPS proxy connection without reading the origin response
observedBoundaries: Only complete origin write reaches the overridden getresponse
Exactly one sleep(3.0) occurs while the connection is still open and origin getresponse has not run
Write failure performs no sleep and leaves requestBytesWritten and postWriteLingerCompleted false
Prior standard proxy/NO_PROXY/CONNECT/TLS and proxy-auth-only-to-CONNECT guarantees are unchanged
Delay completion is recorded explicitly and is not a persistence claim
realAcceptanceRemaining: Root-authorized one request with original lost_receipt UUID/body/capability; independently observe real D1 before any retry. First immediate-close attempt remains retained as unknown/no observed D1 row; this patch does not guarantee persistence.
